thag6.9:0.4: Thag 6:9 Jenta, the Royal Chaplain’s Son
thag6.9:1.1:
I was
drunk with the intoxication
of my birth,
thag6.9:1.4:
Drunk with the intoxication
of my body’s build, coloring, & form,
I wandered about,
thag6.9:2.1:
regarding no one
as my equal or better.
thag6.9:2.4:
haughty,
my banner held high.
I—disrespectful, arrogant, proud—
thag6.9:3.3:
or those commonly held
in respect.
thag6.9:4.4: arrayed with a squadron of monks—
thag6.9:5.4:
to him, supreme
among all living beings.
